semiconductor_relevance: High — Silicon Creations provides critical silicon IP used in a wide range of semiconductor applications.
summary: Silicon Creations specializes in developing silicon intellectual property (IP) for precision timing solutions, including PLLs, SerDes, and high-speed I/Os. Their IP is used across a broad spectrum of technologies from 2nm to 180nm CMOS, supporting applications in smartphones, consumer electronics, and medical devices.
